panels.description: Mera enters the civic archive holding her pearl-grey Covenant band. Keep upper entrance clear.
Mera projects Keel's cloudy water, halted production and rising allocation alerts over the archive table. Keep upper projection clear.
Alex faces Mera across the projected evidence. Keep upper projection clear.
Mera opens a lower transit door toward a civic systems chamber. Keep upper doorway clear.

items.speaker: MERA
items.text: Someone must answer before this spreads.

items.speaker: MERA
items.text: Come see what happens when nobody can decide.
